performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Empty session loses Vary 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>save_session now returns before adding Vary: Cookie when an unmodified empty session was
>accessed. A shared cache may therefore reuse that response for a request with a populated session,
>producing incorrect or session-dependent output.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/sessions.py[R365-367]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6210/files#diff-be4c249245e3745ed5ae394ab2256b76bff507a7eca1aeebdc39b11097c67a8fR365-R367) > >```diff >+ # Add a "Vary: Cookie" header if the session was accessed at all. >+ if session.accessed: >+ response.vary.add("Cookie") >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>SessionMixin.accessed documents that Vary: Cookie will be added whenever the session is
>accessed. In the reordered implementation, an empty session reaches the unconditional return at line
>363, so the new check at lines 365-367 is unreachable unless the empty session was modified and
>independently received the header during cookie deletion.
>
> > [src/flask/sessions.py[46-50]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/de3d7e3aaab1fc202a231f02cdb6ea016748a7b0/src/flask/sessions.py/#L46-L50) > [src/flask/sessions.py[348-367]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/de3d7e3aaab1fc202a231f02cdb6ea016748a7b0/src/flask/sessions.py/#L348-L367) > [docs/templating.rst[258-261]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/de3d7e3aaab1fc202a231f02cdb6ea016748a7b0/docs/templating.rst/#L258-L261) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Accessed empty sessions return from `save_session` before `Vary: Cookie` is added, allowing responses to be cached without accounting for the request cookie. > >## Issue Context >`SessionMixin.accessed` explicitly guarantees that `Vary: Cookie` is added when true. Preserve the cookie deletion behavior while ensuring every accessed session, including an empty unmodified one, receives the header. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/sessions.py[348-367] >- tests/test_basic.py[237-276] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
